decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007910 posted on 2026-09-05 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 49 days later, under the 120-day limit. The ledger does show a duplicate. TXN-007909 and TXN-007910 both posted on 2026-09-05 at RIVERSIDE GADGETS (MER-000068), each for 22921 EUR minor units, from the same transaction date of 2026-09-04. Both carry authorisation AUTH-008117, so one authorisation was posted twice. However, the merchant has already refunded the extra posting. Refund TXN-007911 for 22921, posted on 2026-09-11, refunds TXN-007910. Under the policy, when the duplicate posting has already been refunded, nothing remains in dispute and the dispute is declined.
